title: Investigation of the Effectiveness and Sustainability of a Digital Prevention Measure.
summary: The importance of preventive measures for health and occupational participation has increasingly come into focus in recent years. The RV Fit-Flex model project addresses this need by enabling digital participation independent of location and time. The scientific monitoring of the project aims to evaluate the effectiveness and quality of the program. In particular, the sustainability of possible behavioral changes is also a focus of the investigation.
